messages:
zoe_partners: Quick heads-up  Aurora Insurance renewed and is now live on GCP Marketplace. They signed a 12-mo Dedicated renewal + marketplace listing today.

ben_sales: Huge!! Any early win metrics from the pilot?

harry_eng: Pilot summary: enabled per-route KV caching + adaptive batching. Result: ~38% reduction in GPU-hours and p95 latency for claims scoring down from ~540ms to ~230ms. Also verified end-to-end logging for compliance.

rachel_marketing: Amazing numbers. Do we have permission for logo + quote? Need to draft blog and social.

legal-bot: Marketing assets approved; signed consent form uploaded to Docs.

zoe_partners: Confirmed. Aurora approved a short quote and co-marketing. They prefer a gated case study and a small public blog snippet.

ben_sales: Can we get a short engineering blurb and a dashboard screenshot? Sales wants a 1-pager for AE enablement.

harry_eng: I'll export the latency graph and write a 2-line tech blurb: mention adaptive batching, quantized nightly models, and route-specific fallbacks. Will attach by EOD.

ops-bot: task created: "Aurora GCP marketplace + case study"  assignees: rachel_marketing, harry_eng, ben_sales. Due: 2026-07-05. Link: https://redwood/ops/tasks/4388

rachel_marketing: I'll draft the blog + gated case study form. Posting initial drafts to #marketing-review tomorrow morning.

ben_sales: I'll prep the enablement one-pager and include talking points on reserved capacity, onboarding SLA, and marketplace procurement notes.

zoe_partners: We'll feature this in the partner update and mention at next all-hands. Great work team :tada:

harry_eng: Quick note for the appendix: include snippet for the `batch_warmup.sh` script and the config diff for `redwood-route.yaml`. Two tiny code blocks.

rachel_marketing: Noted. Also request from Aurora: co-hosted webinar in August. I'll coordinate dates.

zoe_partners: Closing loop: legal  done, customer sign-off  done, assets (in progress), blog draft (in progress). Target publish: gated case study + public snippet in two weeks.

ben_sales: Nice momentum for Q3 bookings.
